title: The Predator Stops
shot: deep-focus shot from inside the cave looking out
camera: locked, anchored inside the cave; the predator plays outside the mouth
action: From inside the cave: the predator arrives at the entrance, stops at the threshold, sniffs, hesitates, and slowly retreats. KAIRO is a small silhouette at frame-left edge, pressed against the rock.
lighting: bright exterior blown out, interior silhouette crushing to black
audio: sniffing, a low confused growl, then paw steps fading; cave reverb tail
dialogue_fa: ولی یه چیز عجیب اتفاق افتاد... اون حیوان رسید به دهانه غار، اما داخل نیومد. انگار از چیزی می‌ترسید!
gloss_en: But something strange happened... that animal reached the mouth of the cave, but it didn't come in. As if it was afraid of something!
continuity: predator must never cross the threshold
same cave mouth shape as S12/S13
transition: the predator's retreat empties the frame, motivating S15
image_prompt: View from deep inside a cave looking out at the bright entrance. The cave mouth is a jagged bright opening; a huge prehistoric predator stands just outside it, hesitant, head lowered, one paw raised, refusing to step over the threshold. Inside, rock walls fall into black, and a small stickman silhouette presses against the left wall. 2D cinematic animation, silhouettes against blown-out light.
video_prompt: Locked shot from inside the cave. The predator arrives at the mouth, stops dead, sniffs the air, shifts its weight forward then back, and slowly retreats out of frame. Dust and heat shimmer in the doorway. The interior remains black throughout.
